C-EXPORT-SETTINGS-SECTION.IntentSummary: Backlog endgame (recorded 2026-10-23): the settings modal leaves every export flow — its parameters (the C-EXPORT-SINGLE-PAGE single-page form) relocate into an Export section of Preferences with immediate-apply semantics; PDF/HTML exports go straight to the save dialog with remembered options exactly as Word and ⌘P already do; the existing quiet "Export settings" notice action opens the section. Execution is strictly sequenced after C-EXPORT-SINGLE-PAGE (PR #188) merges; this plan's final task criteria are re-verified against the merged state before any edit (rebase sanction for the relocated-form details).

Corner.Situation: File › Export to PDF on a fresh install
Corner.Expected: straight to the save dialog with factory defaults (never a settings dialog); output identical to a pre-change export with default options
export → notice "exported" with quiet "Export settings" → ⌘, opens at the Export section → change orientation → next export correct; no modal at any point
every control applies immediately to the remembered options (the same store the exports read); Reset restores factory defaults; changes never trigger an export

Corner.Situation: Titlebar popover and tab-menu entries after the flip
Corner.Expected: the C-DOC-POPOVER-EXPORT-HUB buttons and the tab-menu group behave one-click for all formats with zero popover changes (visual identity preserved)
hydrates in the section without errors; missing keys fall back to defaults (the C-EXPORT-SINGLE-PAGE corner-8 guarantee relocates intact)
print-export and export-office specs updated exactly once: settings-dialog mounts drop to zero for every format; invoke order save-dialog-first; ⌘P print path untouched

T-001.Title: Export section in Preferences: relocate the single-page form (sections, hydration, presets, strips, Reset) into prefComponents as a first-class section with immediate-apply semantics writing the remembered options; settings-window entry and section navigation

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: corners 3, 5: the section applies every change to the remembered store immediately (REMEMBER_EXPORT_OPTIONS semantics, no Export button); Reset intact; relocated dialog suites green in their new home; re-verified against the merged PR #188 form before implementation starts.

T-002.Title: Modal-less dispatch: pdf/styledHtml commands ride the remembered options straight to the save dialog (Word precedent in store/editor.js); the dialog shell and the showExportDialog bus surface are removed; popover and tab-menu entries flip to one-click with no visual change

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: corners 1, 4: zero settings-dialog mounts on any export path; payload shape byte-compatible; corner-1 output parity on a defaults export; the popover buttons untouched visually.

T-003.Title: Notice retarget + locales: the quiet "Export settings" action opens Preferences at the Export section for all three formats; dead dialog keys removed across ten locales

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: corner-2: the correction loop completes without a modal; locale parity green after key churn.

T-004.Title: E2e expectation updates + graph retarget: print-export/export-office specs move to save-dialog-first expectations; M-072/V-M-072 retargeted to the section surface; full suite and grace gates

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: corner 6: both e2e specs green with the new expectations; full vitest green; grace lint target/final clean; M-072 contract describes the section.

Correctness.Note: F1: the plan is written against the PR #188 branch state, not merged main — disposition: explicit re-verify sanction in the IntentSummary and T-001 criteria (re-measure the relocated form before any edit). F2: MustNotContain showExportDialog — the removal must also cover the notification quiet action and commands imports, or lint-green dead code remains — disposition: T-002 scope names the bus surface removal, T-003 the retarget.

Security.Note: No new capabilities: Preferences open is an existing surface; the section writes only the existing prefs/localStorage key.

UX.Note: Immediate-apply is standard settings semantics and the backlog decision; the one-off override loss is the recorded conscious v1 trade (⌥-click stays v1.5).

Performance.Note: The section mounts lazily inside the settings window; export paths lose a dialog hop.

Correctness.Note: F1/F2 dispositions verified; task graph acyclic (T-001 → T-002/T-003 → T-004); observed scope covers every file the criteria touch.
